title: M4: Proven in phase: the 10-minute drift harness and the DAW checklist
description:
## Purpose
Prove the initiative's Definition of Done: **two peers stay in phase over a 10-minute run, measured**, natively and in the browser, and check it by ear with a real DAW.

## Scope
- Native harness `crates/apricity-link/tests/drift.rs` (`#[ignore]`, run on purpose): a scripted reference peer (the "DAW": tempo changes mid-bar, a ramp, a stop and a restart) and Apricity playing the click score in the same session; clicks are found in Apricity's output and compared with the reference peer's beats at the same host time; a JSON report (max, p99, first failure, re-warps) written under `renders/` (ignored by git).
- Browser harness `web/scripts/link-drift.mjs`: headless Chrome against `apricity serve --link`, the same script and report.
- The manual DAW checklist in `design/link.md`, run and logged.

## Out of scope
Continuous CI runs of the 10-minute harness (too slow for every push; the owner may schedule it). Multi-machine network tests beyond the manual checklist.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  R[reference peer: scripted tempo, stop, start] -- Link --> A[Apricity peer]
  A --> O[output frames + host times]
  O --> K[click finder]
  R --> B[reference beats at host time]
  K & B --> E[phase error per click] --> J[report JSON: max, p99, first failure]
```

## Definition of Done
1. `features/link/phase.feature` green (the harness is its runner); tolerances as agreed in M0 (proposal: native 3 ms, browser 10 ms, p99 and max).
2. Rust (native harness) and TypeScript (browser harness); no Python.
3. The report format is documented in `design/link.md`; no stored format, so no schema.
4. CLI: none new.
5. Fixtures: M1's click fixture; the WAV is generated.
6. `design/link.md` "Measuring phase" and "Checking with a DAW" sections.
7. `docs/tools.md` Tests section lists both harnesses and says they are not in `cargo test --workspace`.
8. Web: none beyond the harness.
9. Verify: `export PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH && CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-link --test drift -- --ignored --nocapture` (about 11 minutes, under the 20-minute cap); `node web/scripts/link-drift.mjs`; the DAW checklist.
10. Running log with the numbers from each run.
11. `feat`/`chore(<task id>)`; not breaking.
12. Depends on M2 and M3; the browser harness also on apricitus-94da2e (Playwright smoke).
